content: As of now, the tallest building in the world is the **Burj Khalifa** in **Dubai, United Arab Emirates**. It stands at an incredible height of **828 meters (2,717 feet)** with 163 floors. The Burj Khalifa has held this title since its completion in **2010** and is a stunning example of modern engineering and architectural achievement.
